name: Consumption file
description: Supplier configuration grouping consumption statements for a condominium.

condo_id.label: Condominium
condo_id.description: Condominium concerned by the consumption file.
condo_id.help: Select the condominium that owns this configuration.

suppliership_id.label: Suppliership
suppliership_id.description: Supplier contract associated with the consumption file.
suppliership_id.help: The contract must belong to the selected condominium.

code.label: Code
code.help: Enter the identifier used for this supplier configuration.

name.label: Name
name.description: Display name composed of the supplier name and file code.

status.label: Status
status.help: Validation locks the condominium, suppliership and code.

consumption_file_sections_ids.label: Sections
consumption_file_sections_ids.description: Accounting sections configured for the file.
consumption_file_sections_ids.help: At least one complete section is required for validation.

consumption_file_lots_ids.label: Property lot references
consumption_file_lots_ids.description: Supplier references matched with property lots.
consumption_file_lots_ids.help: Missing references are generated when the file is validated.

action.sync_property_lots.label: Import property lots
action.sync_property_lots.description: Import condominium property lots that are not yet present in the consumption file.

action.validate.label: Validate
action.validate.description: Validate the file and generate missing property lot references.

errors.missing_code: A consumption file code is required.
errors.missing_complete_section: At least one complete section is required.
errors.file_already_validated: The condominium, suppliership and code cannot be changed after validation.
